chain_words.nuance: noticeably big, but not dramatically so
clearly big in size or amount
very big, often informal in tone
extraordinarily large, almost beyond ordinary measure

explanation: These words all describe great size, moving from a moderately big amount up to an extraordinarily vast one.

usage_notes.difference: 'Large' is a neutral description of size; 'huge' is stronger and often suggests a striking or surprising degree of size.
